name: aloe barbadensis leaf
purpose: 1. Protects against UV rays and reduces photodamage 2. Replenishes skin moisture and improves dryness 3. Maintains skin hydration and enhances radiance 4. Soothes skin discomfort and increases tolerance
uses: 1. 15-20 minutes before going out, apply sunscreen evenly to the parts of your face and body that need sun protection, massage until fully absorbed and a natural film is formed. 2. If you need to put on makeup, please use it before putting on makeup. If you are exposed to the sun for a long time, you need to reapply every 2-3 hours.
otcwarn: Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
